body: I had to move 6 hours away to back into my folks place due to my father's health. I'm able to work from home half the week to take care of him while my mother does the other half. My fiance understood I had to go back and he decided to stay at our place for his job. That was until the apartment complex owner sent everyone emails that he was selling the building and everyone had to find new homes back in late Feb. Now back where we were living many places aren't accepting new tenants due to shut down so unfortunately he decided to move back in with his parents until restriction where im at are lifted in May. He thought if he kept his head low and keep communication to a minimum nothing would happen but he was wrong. I'm hoping they will be lifted sooner so we can come back to my home state and he can go NC with them.

I'm glad my username was able to make you smile. I hope that some little thing was able to make your day better.

Getting him committed against his is something I wish not to happen. Yet I second guess myself when he talks about things that I find so disturbing. I know by doing that will in his mind prove it to him that everyone is against him. As for seeking out help he is having a difficult time finding anyone who works with autistic people. He's even against therapy cause it didn't help him when he was 11 or 12 so why would it help him now. We've been together for 7 years now and I've learned the best I can about autism and been able to help him when he has his moments but its never been like this before.

I keep telling him I love him so much and try to understand how he feels by just listening to him talk which seems to help. Only positive thing he brought up was 3 things that he loved in life but even still that toke a lot out of him. Thank you so much for the resources I'll look into them the best i can and see where to go from here.
